title: Normalize the actual Gaussian expectation at the selected tilt
source_anchor: Appendix B.2.2 Proposition B.7 proof: Eq21 plus Eq22–23 and the real-power prefactor substitution preceding Eq24 in A2.SS2.SSS2.p5
target_statement: For natural \(n\ge3\) and real \(\kappa\ge4\), put \(s=\sqrt\kappa\), \(r=(1-1/n)(s-1)/(s+1)\) and \(\ell=(4ns+(s-1)^2)/(8n(n-1))\). Let \(\mu\) be normalized Haar probability on full \(O(n)\), \(U=O_{11}\), \(A_O=((\kappa+1)/2)I-((\kappa-1)/4)(O+O^\top)\), and \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\) on actual Euclidean space. Define \(q(O)=((s+1)U-(s-1))/(1+r^2-2rU)^{n/2}\), with real half-dimension powers. Then \(q\in L^1(\mu)\) and \(\mathbb E_\mu[\det(O)\int e^{-\ell\|x\|_2^2}\,d\gamma_O]=[(-1)^{n-1}(s-1)^{n-1}/(s+1)^n](1-1/n)^{n/2}\mathbb E_\mu q\). Positivity and all required domains and L1 are proved internally; no sphere law or Poisson value is assumed.
